shortDescription: Sociedad Química & Minera de Chile NYSE:SQM sank 6.3% in Wednesday's trading after missing Q3 earnings estimates and warning that lithium product prices may be set for a substantial decline in the current quarter.SQM NYSE:SQM reported Q3 net profit of $544.2M, triple from the year-earlier quarter…

children: sank 6.3% in Wednesday's trading after missing
estimates and warning that lithium product prices may be set for a substantial decline in the current quarter.

reported Q3 net profit of $544.2M, triple from the year-earlier quarter, as revenue rose 80% Y/Y to $2.11B but came in slightly below analyst expectations; the company sold 78.9K tons of lithium products in the quarter, up 8% Y/Y, but lithium revenue surged 151% to $1.52B, representing 72% of total sales.
While continuing to see "encouraging demand trends" for lithium, SQM
said its Q3 average realized lithium sales price rose 123% Y/Y but fell 10% Q/Q to $19.60/kg, and it expects moderating prices to continue in Q4.

"In recent weeks, we have observed a significant decline in market prices, which suggests that our average realized lithium sales price in the fourth quarter could be substantially lower," CEO Ricardo Ramos said.

"Although lithium market prices have significantly declined since the peak observed during the second quarter, we continue to see strong appetite for lithium, supported not only by electric vehicle adoption, but also by increasing lithium content in vehicles, the expansion of markets beyond China, and the growing contribution of battery energy storage systems," Ramos said.
The company maintained its previous production guidance of 280K-290K tons this year.

title: SQM slides after warning lithium prices may decline 'substantially'
